notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.4 is a speed release, and the packages stay in the same small size class as 2.0.3. Downloads now use dynamic segmentation: when one connection slows down, the connections that finish early take over the unstarted remainder of its segment instead of waiting, so a single slow connection no longer sets the pace for the whole file. Video downloads no longer split their connections evenly between picture and sound — the video stream, which carries most of the bytes, gets all but two of them, which matters on sites that cap the speed of each connection. Downloads also start sooner: starting one used to probe the server twice and now probes once, a brief network hiccup during that probe is retried instead of failing the start, and the video picker opens with its quality list already resolved in the background. The download list gains a checkbox column — tick any mix of rows with the mouse alone and delete them together. Everything else is unchanged.
